original.statement: The ingester setting max_transfer_retries (-ingester.max-transfer-retries) is removed in favor of the Write Ahead Log (WAL).

decision.reason: [ev-c6e07f70e7d9] says the setting `max_transfer_retries`, with flag `-ingester.max-transfer-retries`, "is removed" in favor of the WAL, so the change type "removed" fits. The subject copies the flag exactly as the text writes it, with a single leading dash. It names the ingester as the owning component because the text calls this an "Ingester configuration" setting. [ev-b19cd3bb8e8b] lists alternatives to the setting, not a renamed flag, so no replacedBy is needed.
